pages.title: From Grain to Dough
pages.text: Grind grain in a Mincer and make Dough in a Crafting Bowl.

pages.title: From Grain to Dough
pages.text: Connect the harvest to dough and ingredient preparation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Put suitable grain in the Mincer and hold right-click. Add the dough recipe ingredients to the bowl and stir with an empty hand.

pages.title: Crank the mincer
pages.text: Hold right-click to work the Mincer with a valid ingredient. Collect the ground result below.

pages.title: Stir the crafting bowl
pages.text: Add the recipe ingredients to the Crafting Bowl and stir with an empty hand. It produces dough, salads and supported feeds.

pages.title: Work traits help a pickaxe on appropriate stone, a shovel on vali
pages.text: Work traits help a pickaxe on appropriate stone, a shovel on valid soil and an axe on logs. A correct tool and supported block are required, rather than any hit on a surface.
